title: Edible coatings with Levilactobacillus brevis QD‐1 cell‐free supernatant enhance antifungal protection and quality maintenance of postharvest bananas
content:
Abstract

BACKGROUND

Postharvest fungal infections are a major cause of fruit spoilage, with bananas being highly perishable and vulnerable to decay. This study investigated Levilactobacillus brevis QD-1 as a biological control agent, evaluating the antifungal and antioxidant properties of its cell-free supernatant (CFS) and its application in an edible coating (EC-QD-1) for maintaining banana quality during storage.

RESULTS

In vitro analyses revealed that CFS from L. brevis QD-1 exhibited strong antifungal activity, with inhibition rates ranging from 56.80% to 78.15%, and demonstrated antioxidant properties. The bioactivity remained stable after pH neutralization and heat treatment. In vivo application of EC-QD-1 on bananas effectively prevented fungal invasion and maintained fruit integrity for up to 9 days. Treated bananas showed significantly lower weight loss (6.62% versus 12.46%), higher firmness and moderated ripening indicators compared to untreated controls. Moreover, EC-QD-1 significantly inhibited the activities of polyphenol oxidase and peroxidase, reducing enzymatic browning. Metabolomic analysis further identified 204 features, including organic acids (acetic, benzoic and butanoic acid derivatives), cyclic diketones/diones (notably piperazinediones) and bioactive peptides (axinastatin 1, desferrichrome A and microcolin B), which collectively support the antifungal and antioxidant activities of CFS.

CONCLUSION

These findings demonstrate that L. brevis QD-1-derived CFS, particularly when applied through an edible coating, is a promising natural alternative to chemical fungicides. Its dual antifungal and antioxidant actions offer an effective strategy for extending the shelf life and preserving the quality of postharvest bananas, contributing to safer and more sustainable postharvest management practices. © 2025 Society of Chemical Industry.
